title: Restriction of the algebra sheaf preserves every homogeneous subgroup.
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a quasi-coherent commutative graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra with homogeneous sheaves $A_n$ and a decomposition isomorphism $\bigoplus_{n\ge 0}A_n\xrightarrow{\sim}A$ as in [def-nagata-relative-proj] and [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. For an affine open $V\subseteq X$ and $n\in\mathbb N$, let
$$
G_n(V):=\operatorname{im}\bigl(A_n(V)\longrightarrow A(V)\bigr)
$$
be the homogeneous section subgroup. If $W\subseteq V$ are affine opens, $h:W\le V$, $a\in A(V)$ and $a\in G_n(V)$, then the restriction of $a$ to $W$ lies in $G_n(W)$:
$$
\operatorname{res}_{W,V}(a)\in G_n(W).
$$
In the source notation this is
```lean
theorem restriction_mem {V W : X.affineOpens} (h : W ≤ V) (n : ℕ)
    (a : A.sections V) (ha : a ∈ A.sectionGrade V n) :
    (A.algebra.obj.right.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom a ∈ A.sectionGrade W n
```
